items.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Booty and I was, we was in high school together in Dayton, Ohio, at the Dunbar High School. Teacher was Francoise, Clarence Francoise. And so, we was in the band.

ctx.x: I was in like about, I was in like the ninth grade then and they wanted me to come over to Wilberforce. Francoise told my mother, ―Don't let him go to Wilberforce because if you do, they don‘t treat the kids in high school like they do the college kids.‖ And my mother believed him and she didn‘t let me go. And he wanted me over there at Wilberforce; I wished it that had happened. Well a couple years later I ran off from home, I really did, and that‘s the way I got out of, I was like in about the tenth grade, I…
Chick Carter, ok, before we get to Chick Carter, before we get there, lets go back and look at your early music training. You come from a musical family, correct?
